title: Presentation: Nickel - Strengthening Global Partnerships
gist: Member-only Benchmark Week 2026 video page for a presentation by Appian Capital Advisory's Head of Commodity Research Melody Dong (Nov 10, 2026). No transcript; the agenda frames international collaboration as key to resilient nickel and cobalt supply chains, covering market trends, investment opportunities and cross-border partnerships.
